bio: Teresa Francisca Benitez-Thompson (born July 25, 1978) is an American politician and former social worker who is the United States representative-elect from Nevada's 2nd congressional district. Previously, she served in the Nevada Assembly from 2010 to 2022, representing the 27th district in Washoe County. A member of the Democratic Party, she served as majority leader of the Assembly from 2016 to 2022.
